[R633] POSITIVE - exact head 97907c2e966035b64fcc8d9fa2e4b8a56e5f93ab

Round R633-3, external independent review of issue #734 / PR #735.
Tree: `5d3882e64db8e496d3f47221192324de6d5b40fd`.
Source base: `a0f39ad4f4bfc9ed4805bac049c4f2b926a94ec0`.
All five lenses are CLEAN. No open BLOCKER, MAJOR or MINOR remains. One optional prior suggestion is retained and one prose-only RESIDUE is recorded. This is a source-review verdict; hosted/replay acceptance and the current-dev merge candidate remain the manager's duties.

The review reconstructed AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/README.md, the [issue](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/734) and its [initial assignment](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/734#issuecomment-6151273761), [round-2 decision](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/734#issuecomment-6151933918), and [round-3 decision](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/734#issuecomment-6152693618). It then examined REQUIREMENTS.md:305-317, especially REQ-VER-04; CI_WORKFLOWS.md; the submodule interface/pin table at docs/reference/SUBMODULES.md:20; the complete `a0f39ad4..97907c2e` diff and six-commit history; and finally the [published executable evidence](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/128a041a0778e66955dde66e66452fe6d0e9e62c/review-evidence/734-r1).

The independent verdict and all-five-lens ledger were written to `INDEPENDENT_VERDICT.md` before opening earlier public reviewer findings or reports. Prior findings were subsequently reconciled and their probes rerun. No private author material, management workspace, or other private review material was read. No prior verdict substitutes for executable evidence here.

**Source behavior and artifact-specific results**

[R633] PASS Conformance - `.github/workflows/rtl.yml:115`, `.github/workflows/rtl-fast.yml:46`, `.github/workflows/elaborate.yml:104`; `independent-scope.log` - All three selectors implement the live-base composition rule authorized in rounds 2 and 3. Hosted scope compares `GITHUB_SHA^1` to `GITHUB_SHA`; replay requires a unique merge base, composes the verified live ref with the PR head using `merge-tree --write-tree`, and compares live with the resulting tree. The recorded base SHA remains metadata. The replay file sets agree with hosted for restored RTL, base-side renames into gate-read paths, and identical edits already present on dev. Source acceptance items 1-4, as amended by those public decisions, are met. Item 5's remote acceptance remains pending with the manager.

[R633] PASS RTL - Full eight-file diff; `scripts/act_ci.py:1840`, :2376, :6204, :6416, :6477; `integrity-final.log`, `images.log`, `image-comparison.json` - Runner architecture retains the verified live-base trust/fetch boundary. The flat isolated installation requires no sibling module and honors the explicit worktree. Product HDL, firmware, configurations, synthesis inputs, interface authorities and all five gitlinks are unchanged. Every independently rebuilt linked-image pair is byte-identical. No new clock, reset, CDC, wire protocol or product interface behavior is introduced.

[R633] PASS Robustness - `scripts/ci_scope_history.py:17`, :234, :267; all three selector bodies; `environment-probe.log`, `prior-external.log` - Missing revisions, unrelated or ambiguous replay ancestry, and replay merge conflicts fail without a documentation-only result. Empty deltas remain relevant. REV, REV+E, restore-inside-merge, fast-forward restore, restored gitlinks, deletion, rename into documentation, and own RTL followed by a dev merge remain relevant. Ambient signing settings and exported `GIT_DIR` cannot redirect fixture operations; the complete scope selftest passes and the victim repository's Git files remain byte-identical. Fixture identities/dates, global/system config and automatic maintenance settings are fixed.

[R633] PASS Tests - `scripts/ci_scope.py:521`, `scripts/ci_scope_history.py:286`, `scripts/ci_events.py:6424`, `scripts/act_ci.py:6453`, :6477, :15422; gate/probe receipts below - The shipping shell bodies are executed against real Git histories with explicit path and relevance oracles. Rule-removal controls reject frozen-base comparisons, endpoint replay, omitted composition, RTL-as-docs, removed gitlink handling and non-conservative empty scope. The standalone runner contract rejects removed, discarded and zeroed history results, and a restored sibling import. Both runner invocation forms pass inside a disposable boundary.

[R633] PASS Docs - `docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md:168`, :199, :230, :674, :688, :789, :892, :1545, :1601; `scripts/act_ci.py:2376`; `focused-docs.log`, `doc-format.log` - The live-base rule, frozen-base failure, composition safety argument, environment bindings, unique-ancestry/conflict refusals, and flat-install contract match the implementation. Current-dev builder and full native banks still validate composition before every merge. Documentation, paths, style, generated contents/anchors, added em-dashes, source lists, evidence readers and Python idiom checks pass.

Each scope checkout explicitly requests `fetch-depth: 0` (`rtl.yml:46`, `rtl-fast.yml:33`, `elaborate.yml:75`). The unchanged runner fetch at `act_ci.py:1840` materializes full live-base and PR-head history and verifies both fetched tips. Every changed-path diff disables rename detection, retaining deletion/source paths. Fast push events retain before-to-after comparison and unknown-before fallback; full and elaboration non-PR events remain unconditional. Draft RTL remains relevant while exhaustive work is deferred. Failed full selectors cannot select a successful no-op aggregate (`rtl.yml:398`, :580); the fast aggregate requires selector success (`rtl-fast.yml:488`, :501).

**Independent B16 reproduction**

The real objects `49da9fd974e8805d56c90e29dcfcb67994c2c430` and `f1b2489f5b1c929e81eeae79a469b2b27c47e340` reproduce 64 endpoint paths with default rename detection, 65 with `--no-renames`, and exactly two merge-base paths:

- `docs/findings/629_MEDIA_CLOCK_FOLLOWING_BENCH.md`
- `docs/findings/README.md`

All three current selectors, hosted and replay, classify those two paths as documentation against both the recorded base and B16's actual landing base `e81ce82f9aa3e4dcaffa5bcdf7e60f0c7cffd80c` (first parent of `6c810c45`). Against `a0f39ad4`, where B16 has already landed, the delta is empty and all six executions conservatively report relevant. This is the required empty-diff behavior, not a B16 regression. See `independent-scope.log`, `prior-round1.log`, and `prior-external.log`.

The earlier criss-cross note is resolved: replay uses `merge-base --all` and refuses multiple bases; hosted classifies its concrete merge.

Unchanged probe bytes are included under `prior-probes/`, with public blob IDs and SHA-256 provenance. The old round-2 program deliberately expects replay to retain an identical RTL edit already on dev. It therefore exits 1 with exactly three `identical-on-dev` mismatches at the corrected head. These are stale-oracle differences demonstrating the fix. Its unchanged history/execution functions, graded separately against round 3's equality requirement, pass 39 pairs. The unchanged rename script also hardcodes the former three-dot formula; it still demonstrates that formula's divergence. Executing the current selectors on its unchanged fixture resolves all three cases. Neither historical program was edited to manufacture a pass.

**Retained suggestion R632-2-S2. Severity: SUGGESTION. All attributable lenses: Robustness.**

Artifact: `.github/workflows/rtl.yml:123`, `rtl-fast.yml:55`, `elaborate.yml:112`.
Authority/evidence: the [prior public finding](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/735#issuecomment-6152686595) and the current step bodies rely on a hosted synthetic merge but do not assert its second parent. No real hosted path violating that contract was found. Impact: an unexpected source-head checkout would classify only its final commit. Optional outcome: assert the hosted merge shape and second-parent identity before classification. Verification: a head-only multicommit RTL-plus-docs fixture should refuse rather than publish docs-only. This remains optional and does not unclean a lens.

**Finding R633-3-R1. Severity: RESIDUE. All attributable lenses: Docs.**

Artifact: PR #735 body, “Linked Issue / roles”. Authority/evidence: the current body contains two consecutive identical `Closes #734` lines. Impact: duplicated prose only; both name the same issue and change no scope, measurement, gate, verdict, clause claim or privacy rule. Exact required wording outcome: remove one duplicate line, leaving a single `Closes #734`. Verification: inspect the published body. The manager may carry this on the residue checklist; it does not affect verdict or lens cleanliness.

Commands and exit status are retained in each named log and `.rc` file. Tests ran with Python 3.14.7 and Git 2.56.0. Candidate runner execution occurred only inside disposable filesystem/process/network namespaces, with read-only candidate access and no host credentials or service socket.

The five ELF sizes are respectively 50752, 50752, 50744, 50768 and 50776 bytes for `endstation_arty_4x4`, `endstation_arty_8ch`, `endstation_arty_current`, `endstation_ax7101_1x1_tdm8` and `endstation_ax7101_8x8`. The claim is independent base/head byte identity, not reproduction of the author's absolute digests. Both sets are recorded in `image-comparison.json`.

**Real limits and retained setup failures**

No live PR replay, host-side candidate runner execution, source fix, source commit, push, GitHub write, merge, author contact, privilege escalation, shared installation or delegated review occurred. Foreground commands ran concurrently and all completed. No full parent, processor, gPTP, synthesis or builder bank ran. The focused image builds do not constitute those banks. Physical calibration NOT RUN; field skips and linked images are not hardware proof.

The original independent fixture accidentally staged an absent gitlink; its corrected path-specific staging then exposed a directory-rename conflict in a synthetic one-file directory. A retained unchanged RTL anchor made that intended file-rename fixture unambiguous. A subsequent assertion incorrectly expected B16 to remain unmerged against current dev; the final probe separately grades the historical landing base and today's empty delta. Initial image runs failed because the builder writes generated configuration files into its source tree; final runs used a disposable writable clone. These setup failures are retained in `probe-setup-failure.*`, `probe-directory-rename-setup.*`, `probe-already-merged-control.*`, `image-readonly-setup.*`, `image-diagnosis.*` and `image-controls-readonly-setup.*`. They are not counted as candidate defects or passing measurements.

At the 19:22:50 UTC hosted snapshot, `changes`, `full-ci-gate`, `bdd-conformance`, `docs-check-no-git`, `wire-accountability`, and two synthesis shards had completed successfully. Other required work was queued or running. Physical gPTP was skipped, not executed. `hosted-observation.json` records the exact-head context states and links; no complete hosted acceptance is claimed. Final public observation found no new review comments, submitted reviews or inline findings beyond the reconciled set.

Final integrity independently hashes every tracked blob rather than trusting status flags: 1308 superproject files, complete index entries/modes, and 562/104/214 files in the required protocol/gPTP/stream-primitive submodules. All five gitlinks match the source base. The three initialized required pins are `2ad2f845dd583f8310075fa2380cb60a04fd091a`, `7dda9c3b4d65cbbb28f72a34e1ee0efe368695d9`, and `48ff7a7e2ef782cf778d47910cf85835c64b1bce`. The remaining external/lwSRP gitlinks are unchanged; their checkouts were not initialized. HEAD, tree and index match the assignment, and the candidate worktree is clean. No source restoration was necessary.

**Pending manager duties**

Publish the report and listed receipts; carry the duplicate-line residue and optional merge-shape suggestion. Obtain both independent current-head reviews and finish all in-flight rounds. Complete trusted replay and hosted acceptance, distinguishing executed gates from skipped contexts. At the merge turn, construct the current-dev candidate, run builder and native banks, and publish their exact-candidate receipts. The supplied source base and live dev for this review are both `a0f39ad4f4bfc9ed4805bac049c4f2b926a94ec0`; this report does not pre-approve a future composition. Preserve the 697c-then-696 ordering, explicit merge authorization, post-merge containment, and issue/project completion requirements.

Only REPORT.md and files listed in MANIFEST.sha256 are publishable. Disposable clones, SDK files, generated files and binaries stay under unpublished `scratch/`.

R633-3 FINISHED
